name: UI Fonts
summary: Browser tool for previewing fonts and pairings in real time, with typography guides and showcase examples.
description: Online font previewer with controls for size, weight, line height and width, plus a two-font pairing mode and links that encode a font setup in the URL. A typography showcase of known sites (Medium, GitHub, Airbnb) and a resources section with pairing guides and best practices support the tool.
contains: real-time font preview with size, weight, line height and width controls
typography showcase of Medium, GitHub and Airbnb type choices
pairing guides and best practices: line length, hierarchy, variable fonts, performance
URL parameters to share a specific font setup
